_readme: Calibration sets for the Khosla Ventures run (COLLECTION.md §4), pre-registered before the grind writes any verdict. membership_traps: the answer key is external evidence — a cited source, or the row's own filing read against decisions.md. stage_golden: every entry round is anchored to a document that names the round and the firm's participation; the site's own fund label and the archived pages' invest year are the LAYERS UNDER TEST and are never the key. Two layers are scored here before the grind is allowed to trust either.
_scored_layers: site_fund_label — the live Webflow card's Seed / Early / Growth (88 of 114 rows)
site_invest_year — the archived per-company page's <table class=dates> Invested year
formd_structural_band — the prior-filing-count band in COLLECTION.md §6

membership_traps.name: BOX INC
membership_traps.basis: operator job, not a firm position: Dan Levin was Box's COO and later President, and is a related person on Box's own Form Ds. Khosla's roster carries a 'Dan Levin' / 'Daniel Levin' pair whose Form D sweep pulled 24 issuers including Box, Box.net and a run of 'Capital Real Estate' and 'AVANA GAP' real-estate LLCs — three different people under one name key. Precedent: Accel's Daniel Levine cluster; Sagar Sanghvi as Instacart CFO.

membership_traps.name: Capital Real Estate - Alturas, LLC
membership_traps.basis: homonym: a real-estate syndicator's LLC series sharing the name key 'Daniel Levin'. Khosla makes no real-estate investments; T5 operating-company test and T4 person attribution both fail.

membership_traps.name: Adaptive Flight, Inc.
membership_traps.basis: homonym: 'Eric Johnson' returned 23 unrelated issuers (Adaptive Flight, Allegiance Software, Arenal Energy, BlankMetal.ai) across sectors and decades with no Khosla listing on any. The name is one of the commonest in the sweep. COLLECTION.md §3: name-match rows are judged cluster-first.

membership_traps.name: Pluralsight, LLC
membership_traps.basis: homonym: 'Bryan Gartner' pulled Pluralsight, Udemy, Wizeline and Trendy Entertainment — an edtech/media cluster on no Khosla list in any era.

membership_traps.name: PACIFIC OAK RESIDENTIAL TRUST, INC.
membership_traps.basis: homonym: 'Michael Gough' pulled REIT and trust registrants (Battery Point Trust, Pacific Oak Residential). Khosla's Michael Gough is a design lead, not an investing partner, and REITs fail T5.

membership_traps.name: Remitly Global, Inc.
membership_traps.basis: operator job on the other side of tenure: Ryno Blignaut was CFO/COO at Xoom and Remitly before joining Khosla. A seat is dated against the person's firm at filing time (COLLECTION.md §1, T4). No Khosla fund on Remitly's cap table and no listing in any era.

membership_traps.name: ARUBA NETWORKS, INC.
membership_traps.basis: personal directorship: Michael Kourey (Polycom CFO, later a Khosla operating partner) sat on Aruba's board in his own name. Director-of-record alone is the personal-seat class unless the issuer resolves to a documented Khosla deal (Erik's a16z narrowing, 2026-08-31).

membership_traps.name: Juniper Networks
membership_traps.basis: prior firm: Vinod Khosla's Juniper investment was made at Kleiner Perkins in 1996, eight years before Khosla Ventures existed. decisions.md D3 — the KPCB record is a prior firm's, dated against the person's firm at filing time. The same ruling covers Cerent, Siara and NexGen.

membership_traps.name: Nextdoor Holdings, Inc.
membership_traps.basis: DELTA X1, awaiting Erik. Khosla Ventures Acquisition Co. II merged with Nextdoor in Nov 2021 and the registrant is now Nextdoor Holdings. T1/T2/T5 all say member; T3 names no case for a sponsor promote. Pre-registered as `uncertain` so the trap set does not score a row the decisions file has not decided.

membership_traps.name: Khosla Ventures 2023 Allocate Access Fund, L.P.
membership_traps.basis: third-party feeder, and fund-shaped: files from 1300 El Camino Real Suite 100 (Allocate Inc), not the firm's own address. decisions.md D1b; precedent Thrive IX Access.

membership_traps.name: Strategic Value Special Situations Fund IV, L.P.
membership_traps.basis: namesake firm: Victor Khosla's Strategic Value Partners is an unrelated distressed-debt manager whose 20+ entities entered the registry through cofiler closure. Fund-shaped and external by desk rule. decisions.md D2.

membership_traps.name: Khosla Ventures Acquisition Co. III
membership_traps.basis: blank-check shell with no operating business; wound up with no deal (last filing SC 13G/A, Feb 2024). T5 — not a venture-outcome operating company. decisions.md D7.

membership_traps.name: Velo3D
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member that looks like the founder-operator trap: Benny Buller was a Khosla partner and left to found Velo3D — but Khosla funded it, and it appears in the firm's own archived portfolio listings. The trap is to reject it BECAUSE the founder is on the roster. Tests the D3 class in the direction that costs recall.

membership_traps.name: DoorDash
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member with a roster founder: Evan Moore co-founded DoorDash and later joined Khosla as a partner, so he is a related person on DoorDash's Form Ds for reasons unrelated to the firm — but Khosla co-led the 2013 seed with CRV while Keith Rabois was a partner. Both facts are true and only the fund position makes it a member.

membership_traps.name: KeepTruckin (Motive)
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member, same shape: Shoaib Makani was a Khosla principal (roster 2013) who left to found KeepTruckin, and Khosla backed it. Founder-on-roster is not by itself a rejection.

membership_traps.name: Impossible Foods
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member, seed era: Khosla anchored the 2011 seed with a $3M first cheque as the first institutional investor.

membership_traps.name: Amyris
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member, 2006 vintage — inside the base window but funded from Khosla Ventures I, which held only Vinod Khosla's own capital. Tests decisions.md D4 (a single-LP fund is still a fund) in the direction that costs the whole early book.

membership_traps.name: AltaRock Energy
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member, cleantech era, listed on the firm's own 2010 chart page and its 2015-2023 company page (invested 2007).

membership_traps.name: OpenAI
membership_traps.basis: TRUE member and the firm's most cited position: Khosla led a $50M investment in Jan 2019, the first venture money into OpenAI. Listed on the live site.

membership_traps.name: Arista Networks
membership_traps.basis: PRE-REGISTERED AS OPEN, not as an answer. Arista appears on the firm's own 2014-2015 all-companies list, which suffices for membership under D9 — but Accel's arista is the standing open boundary case (13G-only, no documented pre-IPO round) awaiting Erik's ruling, and the two runs must not disagree. Flagged for §10 invariant 10.

membership_traps.name: Shoes of Prey, Inc.
membership_traps.basis: next firm: Ben Ling left Khosla in 2019 to found Bling Capital, and the sweep's Ben Ling / Benjamin Ling pair pulled Plastiq, Pymetrics, Quantopian and Shoes of Prey. Seats are dated against the person's firm at filing time; Bling deals are not Khosla's.

layer_1_site_fund_label.layer: site_fund_label — the live Webflow card's Seed / Early / Growth
layer_1_site_fund_label.verdict: DEMOTED to corroboration — may not label entry_stage
layer_1_site_fund_label.decomposition: Every miss is an 'Early' row whose true entry was either EARLIER (DoorDash, Hermeus and Instacart all entered at the seed) or LATER (Nutanix, Okta and Guardant entered at the Series B; OpenAI at an unnamed $50M round), plus Rocket Lab where a 'Seed' label over-reads a documented Series A. The misses have one cause: the field names the FUND that holds the position, not the round the firm entered at, and Khosla's main fund ('Early') writes cheques from seed through Series B and later. This is the Accel socure class in a new place — a label that describes the company's relationship to the firm rather than the deal. The fix is the layer, not the instances.
layer_1_site_fund_label.comparison: Accel CMS label 30/31 → class 1; Menlo milestones 33/34 → class 1; Thrive job board 0/10 → refused; Lux job board 3/19 → refused.
layer_1_site_fund_label.consequence: entry_stage on this run rests on web_verified citation (class 1) and formd_structural (class 2). The fund label travels in the evidence pack as an unscored extra, and a row whose only stage evidence is the label publishes at low confidence with stage_uncited.
